function.name: run_sql
function.arguments: {"sql":"SELECT v.vendor_id, v.vendor_name FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.vendor_bill vb JOIN lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.vendor v ON vb.vendor_id = v.vendor_id WHERE vb.period='2026-09' AND vb.vendor_invoice_no='MRP-88213' LIMIT 1","purpose":"Get vendor name for MRP-88213"}
